page_note: Heavily damaged page (73% damage), but the surviving text is uniformly cosmological substrate teaching. The structural marker 'ⲍⲁⲧⲉⲍⲏ ⲉⲙⲡⲁⲧⲟⲩ-' ('Beforehand, before they...') functions as an enumerative substrate formula introducing successive cosmic establishment acts: the three fossae for binding, the wall around the great sea (the Father of Life's act), the boundary of the sphere, the place of the four winds, the casting of the Palamas/Adamas, the establishment of error/dregs of darkness, the archonic host bound in the seas of the abyss, the abortions cast to earth. This is pure cosmogonic teaching with no editorial frame, no apostolic dialogue, no institutional or hortatory material. Teaching purity = 1.000.
